recentItems.title: STORM SHADOW IS COMING! The countdown for Russia has begun | Europe to replace Starlink for Ukraine
recentItems.description:
Neptune strike on Su-34s, Storm Shadow missiles, and a Starlink alternative for Ukraine. According to Zelenskyy, four Russian bombers were destroyed and two more damaged in Borisoglebsk. The Main Directorate of Intelligence reports the destruction of a drone operator training center in occupied Kherson region. Bloomberg reports that the UK has delivered new Storm Shadow missiles, while France provided licenses for weapon production. The EU is discussing granting Ukraine access to GovSatCom. Also in this episode — flight restrictions in Russia, a shadow fleet tanker after a fire, threats to Ukraine's energy grid, and US-European disputes over frozen Russian assets.

recentItems.title: TURNING POINT IN THE SKIES? Belgium hands over its F-16s! Kremlin panics after EU summit?
recentItems.description:
EU summit in Brussels: Zelenskyy discussed two-year funding for Ukraine, winter preparation, and stepping up pressure on Russia. Belgium plans to deliver ten F-16 fighter jets by the end of 2026 to defend against Russian drones. In the US, 22 lawmakers call on Trump to impose sanctions on Russian officials, banks, and oligarchs by October 18. Zelenskyy met with Péter Magyar for the first time, discussing Ukraine's EU accession, trade, and ending the war. Ursula von der Leyen states that Moscow is violating the energy truce as Europe prepares a new sanctions package.

recentItems.title: 150 KG IN THE AIR! Ukrainians created the first FLYING evacuation drone
recentItems.description:
Stargate drone, casualty evacuation, and Armed Forces of Ukraine ground robots: how Ukrainian technology saves lives on the front line. Operator Starsky reports on the Skyfall development, which, according to the manufacturer, can carry up to 150 kg and travel up to 14 km one way. What capabilities does this aerial evacuation drone possess, how does its defense system work, and why is robotic evacuation becoming increasingly vital? Also featured in this episode — Ratel-H, the "Did" (Grandpa) robot that survived FPV drone strikes, and a 34-km evacuation mission by the Khartia Brigade. We compare the capabilities of aerial and ground platforms and explain what prevents them from completely replacing humans in the most dangerous missions.

recentItems.title: Zelenskyy exposes DELIBERATE SABOTAGE. US Senate takes on Pentagon over Starlink shutdown
recentItems.description:
Starlink in Ukraine and GovSatCom: The EU is preparing an alternative satellite communication system for Kyiv. Negotiations are underway amid SpaceX restrictions that have complicated the operation of interceptor drones. Zelenskyy states: this was a deliberate decision, not a technical glitch. In the US, the Senate is investigating the Pentagon's role, while Ukraine expects to connect to the European system in January. Also in this episode — drone attacks on commercial vessels in the Black Sea, Romania's proposal to create a joint NATO command, and the protection of maritime exports. How are Ukraine and Turkey supporting agricultural shipments, and what is the Ukrainian Navy reporting regarding the fight against sea drones?
